item.description: 255 Berry now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8708009.

item.title: Correction · 255 Berry: 255 Berry's completion is shown as about 2004: the Assessor records year…
item.description: 255 Berry's completion is shown as about 2004: the Assessor records year built 2004, and the developer's page gives a 2001-2004 development range, which is not a completion date. Source: Signature Development Group, 255 Berry (signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/); DataSF Assessor secured roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8708009.

item.description: 255 Berry now shows its construction permit as completed on Aug 10, 2004. Source: DBI building permits via DataSF (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200105159216).

item.title: Correction · 255 Berry: The map notes called the developer Signature Properties and said the…
item.description: The map notes called the developer Signature Properties and said the building was built in 2004; the developer's own page says Signature Development Group and gives a 2001-2004 development range, so a dated correction was added. The 'Signature I' naming and the milestone's 'Channel Park Condominiums' name are not on any cited page and were removed. The notes now give the 99 units and the architect from the developer's project page, which is cited for the residential use. Source: Signature Development Group, 255 Berry (https://signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/).

item.title: Complete · 255 Berry: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction… (Aug 10, 2004)
item.description: Construction permit completed: DBI recorded new-construction permit 200105159216 (7 stories, 100 dwelling units, 255 Berry St) as completed on this date. A permit's completion date is not an opening date. (Aug 10, 2004). Source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, via DataSF.
item.source: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection, via DataSF

item.title: Complete · 255 Berry: 255 Berry completed, about 2004: the DataSF Assessor roll (2025)… (~2004)
item.description: 255 Berry completed, about 2004: the DataSF Assessor roll (2025) gives year built 2004 for lot 8708009 and the building's per-unit lots, and the developer's own project page gives a 2001-2004 development date range (a range, not a completion date); the page also gives $60,000,000 project cost, 99 units, architect McLarand Vasquez Emsiek & Partners (~2004). Source: Signature Development Group's own project page (signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/); https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8708009.
